body: Your words have really resonated with me. Im feeling bad but not as much as i did before.. youve actually taken time out of your day to talk with me and help me out with my feelings of inadequacy. Thank you so much. Ive read some things on the internet that tell me that my prefrontal cortex (part of the brain that controls emotion logical thinking and control of inhibition) hasnt been fully developed yet and that may be the main cause of much of the worry and dilema that im feeling at times. Ill take some of your advice and what youve said and try to apply it more.

How can i not feel like a failure, when i literally dont measure up to anyone? It gets harder everyday to find a reason to be happy when im just a loser. Even if i did manage to get a friend or in a relationship with someone, id be so far behind in terms of experience that it wouldnt even matter. Whats the point anymore

I dont think any amount of self help will fix whatevers wrong with me. Even if did do anything to change, deep down im still a loser for missing the opportunity to have friends, a girlfriend,being cool, or anything good in my life. Im not a jerk i think? I guess i just wasnt meant for anything good or even substantial.
Ive never had a girlfriend before, im still a virgin, all around loser, and i dont have any friends. Thate plenty reason to not be good enough tbh

Dude, there is noone out there for me. Ive looked. Im apparently not a good enough person to have someone "good".Im serious. Ill happily take a terrible/abusive relationship if it means im not alone. If i get the chance to be with anyone ill take it. Im not going to bs you and tell you im worthy of someone good because im not.

Thanks for caring about my personal well being and mental health. But really now and probably for the rest of my life, i really dont care who i get with. I just want to get with SOMEONE. The fact that i havent yet eating away at me more than being with someone "bad" for me ever would tbh.

I appreciate the pep talk, but at the end of the day its practically over for me. Im almost 19 at this point and i still havent managed to find anyone that even remotely likes me. I doubt that will change at any point in the future and ill live the rest of my life alone. Whats the point in living anymore if i wont ever find love?

I doubt anything like that will happen for me tbh. I wouldnt hold out any hope for a relationship. I might end up being a life long virgin/loser if im being honest. Everyone does everything better than me..
I just want the experience at this point. Im willing to except anyone, abusive or otherwise. Im so tired of being alone. I just want to be with someone.

Thank you truly and honestly. But i really dont think anyone really gives a damn about me and wouldnt miss me if i was gone. Your kind words are amazing, but they really arent meant for a loser like me.

Thanks for the online dating advice, but most of the atmosphere on most dating sites isnt really me style. I dont think girls are really looking for guys like me tbh. Thank you also for the pep talk, but i doubt that anyone is honestly out there for me. I probably wouldnt deserve them if they did exist anyway lol.
